Name: Furry Nude Girls
Author: Plebby999
Description:
A conversion to make [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1083]Anthro Characters Continued[/url] Compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20277]Nude Girls[/url]. I also added a patch to help with some overlay compatibility issues and a NPC tweak.

[b]Installation:[/b]
Install all the requirements for ACC and Nude Girls.
Overwrite the portraits and sprites from Nude Girls with this mod.

[b]Credits:[/b]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/2417747]Sion9000[/url] and [url=https://community.playstarbound.com/members/gaveliere.616423/]Gaveliere [/url]for making Anthro Characters Continued.
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/119171613]TrashRacc1124[/url] for making the very naked Nude Girls mod.
